scope: Rejected direct Wan relighting and four bounded-routing iterations on the accepted critical geometry
summary: The direct LoRA video regenerated flowers and scene geometry. Routed v2 leaked into flowers/hands, v3/v4 passed spatial gates but lacked a temporal gate, and lossless v5 exceeded the 1.5 temporal-residual ceiling.
evidence: Direct LoRA proposal was visually rejected for geometry and identity destruction.
v2 flower exactness was 0.984260 and prompted-hand exactness 0.476351.
v3/v4 restored exact protected geometry but did not yet establish temporal acceptance.
v5 maximum relighting residual was 1.581811 RGB MAE, above 1.5.
lessons: Relighting LoRA output is useful only as a bounded luminance proposal, not as a geometry candidate.
Lossless spatial preservation needs an independent temporal residual gate.
limitations: These failed routes cover only 17 frames.
next_actions: Temporally smooth the routed luminance while preserving exact masks.
